purpose: Teach: 眉/ポテト/茹で/間取り/スイカ/ありのまま/体型/嫌う

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、最近、眉、サロンで、整えてもらってるの、私、本当に、印象、変わるよね。
lines.en: Aoi, you've been getting your brows done at a salon lately, haven't you? It really does change your whole look.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle brightness. Slight lean-in, genuine admiration in the tone. Unhurried, noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新作の、ポテトフライ、お客様に、好評よ、葵で、ぜひ、食べてって。
lines.en: Yeah. We've got a new potato-fry special in, and customers are really enjoying it. You should definitely try it when you come by.
lines.style: Bright and present. Light enthusiasm without overselling. The tone of someone recommending something she actually likes, not performing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、夕食、卵を、茹でるだけの簡単メニューよ、私、忙しくて。
lines.en: Lately my dinners have been pretty basic—just boiled eggs, honestly. Work's been hectic enough without getting fancy.
lines.style: Wry, self-aware exhale. Slight laugh at the corner of the admission. Tired but unbothered, matter-of-fact pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新居の間取り、私、考えるの、結構、楽しんでるよ、家、決まったらね。
lines.en: I've actually been having fun thinking about the layout for my new place. Once we finalize which apartment it is, anyway.
lines.style: Softer shift in energy. Quieter, almost private quality. Genuine pleasure underneath—not bragging, sharing something real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夏のスイカ、葵の店でも、出す予定、ある?ジュースとか、流行るかも。
lines.en: Speaking of summer—does your café have plans to put out a watermelon menu? Something with watermelon juice might be a hit.
lines.style: Thoughtful, testing the idea aloud. Engaged but not pushing. Light curiosity, the tone of someone who's actually thinking about her friend's work.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、彼に、ありのままの自分、見せられて、すごくいい関係よね、葵としても、嬉しい。
lines.en: Mei, the way you're able to be yourself around your boyfriend, to let him see you like that—that's really something special. As your friend, it makes me happy to see.
lines.style: Tender and steady. No performance in this—just real warmth. The pace slows slightly, words land with care. Eye-contact held.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、体型、ちょっと、気になってきたの、私、ジム、行ってみようかしらね、葵。
lines.en: Lately I've been noticing my body a bit more, and I'm thinking maybe I should try going to a gym. What do you think?
lines.style: Reflective, gentle self-awareness. Asking without expecting a fix. Tone is vulnerable but grounded, not seeking reassurance so much as thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様、嫌う方が、いらっしゃるサービス、なくしたいわよね、葵で、いつも、意識してる。
lines.en: There are certain things customers don't like about our service, and I want to get rid of those. It's something I'm always aware of when I'm working.
lines.style: Reflective and measured. Quiet conviction underneath—not complaining, problem-solving. Thoughtful pause before the last phrase. Professional care with personal weight.
